name: @moyarich/workspace-tools
description: CLI tooling for Node.js workspaces, package discovery, releases, publishing, dependency checks, and repository automation.
author: Moya Richards

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode issue-dependency-tree && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode discover-packages && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-release && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode sim-version-resolver && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-publish && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-dependency-check && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-package-lock && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-release-identity && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-approved-release
